# Vector Assault Mechanics Glossary

## Thrust-and-Drift
Rotation + forward thrust with momentum persistence. Repositioning is planned vector control, not instant-stop strafing.

## Wraparound Arena
Crossing one screen edge re-enters from opposite edge for ship, hazards, and projectiles.

## Fragmentation Chain
Hazard lifecycle: large -> medium -> small -> destroyed. Fragmentation should increase local clutter and threat.

## Fire Cadence
Governed primary-fire output via projectile cap and/or fire cooldown to prevent uncontrolled spam.

## Panic Reposition
Risky short-range emergency escape (hyperspace-inspired). Must include tradeoff (cooldown, vulnerability, or scoring penalty).

## Overdrive Burst
Temporary offense amplification window with explicit recovery/cooldown.

## Pressure State
Observable run intensity represented by wave/tick, threat density, and motion overlap.

## Score Pressure
Reward model where dangerous targets and high-risk survival decisions accelerate score gain.

## Readability Budget
Maximum practical clutter before silhouettes become ambiguous; used to tune line weight, object count, and spawn tempo.
